note: ALA-LC Moroccan Tamazight Romanization Table (2012; no version year printed on the document, approval date CC:AAM 2012-01-22 from PDF metadata) (https://www.loc.gov/catdir/cpso/romanization/tamazight.pdf; local source interscript-private-references/alalc/alalc-tamazight.pdf). Single-page table, 43 rows, read as printed column streams (left column top-down, then right). Complete: no skipped rows — the table includes the labialized digraphs ⴳⵯ/ⴽⵯ and the tamatart ⵯ, all encodable. The PDF text layer drops the macron-below marks (U+0331) on the ⴲ ⴴ ⴸ ⵝ values and the entire value cells for ⵕ ⵟ ⴺ; those values are transcribed from the printed page image. Decomposed text-layer forms are NFC-normalized (h+U+0323 → ḥ U+1E25, s+U+0323 → ṣ, z+U+0323 → ẓ, d+U+0323 → ḍ). The ⴺ value (d with dot below and macron below) follows the printed glyph with the map's documented mark order (U+0323 then U+0331). The printed ⵄ ⵖ rows carry '(See note 1)' and ⵯ '(See note 2)' reference markers; transcribed as plain values.
